observations: Industrial embroidery machine with 10 embroidery heads.
Brand 'Yunghe' is printed on the machine head in photo 0.
Control panel features a touchscreen and physical buttons.
The machine is shown with multiple spools of thread on a multi-level stand.
A green fabric sample is being stitched on the table.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or showroom environment.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the Yunghe brand and computerized embroidery heads.
photo 0 shows a clean machine with multiple spools and a functional control panel.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motors may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and all heads moving.

risks.risk: The embroidery heads may be dull, damaged, or unable to stitch.
risks.proof: A video showing the heads stitching a test pattern.

risks.risk: The control panel screen may be cracked or have a dead pixel.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the screen while the machine is powered on.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and all heads moving.
Video of the machine stitching a test pattern.
Photo of the machine's identification plate (usually on the side or back).
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
